# OWUnion theme v1.1 change list

**Baseline, v1.0:** `docs/reference/portlandgear-to-blocksy.md`, applied from 2026-10-06.
**Decisions:** [[decisions/004-blocksy-theme-and-conditional-store-headers]]

## How this list works

* One row per change. IDs run `1.1-01`, `1.1-02`, and so on, and never get reused.
* Status: **Proposed**, **Decided**, **Blocked** (waiting on an input named in the row), **In progress**, **Done** (applied on staging and checked), **Live**.
* Labels: `S` confirmed in Blocksy or Companion 2.1.58 source, `T` tested, `K` working knowledge to check.
* Build on staging, then publish. v1.1 is complete when every row is Live or moved to v1.2.

## Changes

### 1.1-01 Per store headers through Blocksy conditional headers

**Status:** Decided 2026-10-06 (decision 004). Blocked: the Claude in Chrome run found Blocksy Pro inactive on the site, and the multiple header screen is a Pro feature. **Labels:** `S` for the conditions, `K` for the Pro multiple header screen.

Steps, for the first store, then repeat:

1. Customize, Header: add a header for the store, starting from a copy of the parent header.
2. Conditions: include "Taxonomy ID" set to the store's brand, and include "Single Product with Taxonomy ID" set to the same brand. Leave the parent header on everywhere else.
3. Store header content: store logo, or the store name in Barlow Condensed until a logo exists. Store navigation. A link back to OWUnion (spec section 1, rule 3).
4. Keep the announcement bar row identical to the parent header so shipping terms read the same everywhere.

First store: Swim Alcatraz (Bryan, 2026-10-06). Build it, check it, then do the rest (spec section 4.1). Claude in Chrome prompt F in `blocksy/claude-in-chrome-header-footer.md`. Until the store logo exists, the header shows the store name as a Text element in Barlow Condensed; the WordPress Site Title is site wide, so it cannot be used per store.

Checks on staging:

* The store's Brand page and one of its products show the store header
* Shop, other stores, cart, checkout, and account show the parent header
* A Hidden store's pages still return 404 (store status plugin)
* After publishing, logged out pages show the right header, so the WP Engine cache is not serving a stale one

### 1.1-02 Breadcrumb shows the store

**Status:** Built 2026-10-06 in the store status plugin, version 0.2.0 (`includes/breadcrumbs.php`, 10 tests). Awaiting the staging check. **Labels:** `S` for the filter, `T` for the logic.

Spec 4.4 calls for "OWUnion / Swim Alcatraz / Hoodies" on product pages. Blocksy builds product breadcrumbs from product categories only, so today it shows "Hoodies" without the store. Blocksy offers the `blocksy:breadcrumbs:items-array` filter. The plugin inserts the product's store before the first category crumb (or before the product title when there is no category), linked to the store page. The parent store is skipped because it is the home item; its slug is assumed to be `owunion`, adjustable through the `owunion_breadcrumb_skip_stores` filter. Hidden stores need no special case, because their products already return 404.

To finish: update the plugin on staging, apply the Breadcrumbs settings in the v1.0 guide (section 4), and open a Swim Alcatraz product. Expected: OWUnion / Swim Alcatraz / Hoodies.

### 1.1-03 Per store accent color

**Status:** Blocked on store colors (spec 4.1). **Labels:** `T` for the CSS method.

* Header colors: set inside each store header from 1.1-01.
* Buttons, links, and focus on the store's pages: one block per store in Additional CSS, `:root:has(> body.store-{slug})` overriding palette Color 1 and Color 2. Tested against Blocksy 2.1.58: the override reaches buttons on that store's pages only.
* Check each accent at 4.5:1 with white text before using it on buttons.

### 1.1-04 Transparent header over the home page hero

**Status:** Proposed. **Labels:** `S` for display conditions on the transparent header and for the Transparent State Logo field.

Matches the reference's header over the hero image (dissection section 3, scheme 4). In Customize, Header, turn on the transparent header and limit its conditions to the home page only. White menu and icons, the reversed logo. Needs a hero photo and the reversed logo from 1.1-05, uploaded to the logo element's Transparent State Logo field.

### 1.1-05 Reversed and vector logos replace the CSS invert

**Status:** Blocked on logo files (SVG, transparent PNG, reversed). **Labels:** none.

Swap the footer Image block to the reversed logo and remove the `owu-logo-reversed` class and its CSS. Use the SVG in the header logo. Per store logos follow in 1.1-01.

### 1.1-06 Returns trust line on the product page

**Status:** Blocked on the returns policy page (spec 4.4, required policy pages).

Replace the placeholder in Single Product, Additional Info with one line that states the policy, linked to the policy page.

### 1.1-07 Size guide on the product page

**Status:** Proposed. **Labels:** `K`.

The reference uses a paid size finder. A size guide table covers it for hoodies and tees. Blocksy Pro's WooCommerce extension includes a size guide that can attach to products by category. Needs measurements from the print on demand vendor's blanks.

### 1.1-08 Rotating announcement messages

**Status:** Blocked until there is a second message. **Labels:** `K` for the method.

The header Text element shows one message. Choose the method when a second message exists.
